jobs.occupation: Line Leader Slicing - Meat Company | Oudenaarde | 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
For a growing food production company in Oudenaarde, we are looking for a Line Leader Slicing. The company specializes in slicing and packaging ham products for various supermarket chains.

As a Line Leader, you will be responsible for the smooth operation of the slicing line. You will coordinate the production process, support and supervise operators, ensure product quality, and make sure all hygiene and safety standards are respected.

Your Responsibilities

• Leading and supporting employees on the slicing line.
• Setting up, monitoring, and adjusting production machines.
• Ensuring product quality and correct packaging.
• Solving minor machine issues and reporting technical problems.
• Monitoring compliance with hygiene, quality, and safety regulations.
• Following up on production targets and reporting results.
The job is not physically demanding!

Early shift: 5:00 a.m.–1:30 p.m.

Late shift: 1:30 p.m.–10:00 p.m.

You get a half-hour break.

Profile

• Previous experience in a production environment is required, preferably within the food industry.
• Experience as a team leader, supervisor, or line leader is an advantage.
• You are detail-oriented and quality-focused.
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system.
• You have good communication and leadership skills.
• You will speak in English, Polish or Ukrainian with your colleagues

Historically recognized as the global benchmark for premium retail equipment and trolley manufacturing, 
Wanzl has successfully evolved into a 
total solutions provider optimizing customer experiences.
 

To support the ambitious course in Belgium and Luxembourg, Wanzl is looking for an entrepreunerial Business Development Manager.  This role is pivotal in driving the new era, turning premium product innovations and digital solutions into sustainable market share.
 

As Business Development Manager, you act as 'co-architect' of the business transformation in BeLux, supporting the General Manager. You combine traditional sales with high-level strategic business development to gain market share with new, digital, and automated solutions. You pioneer new growth areas while further expanding existing strategic partnerships.
 
 

• You further design and implement a sustainable go-to-market strategy to successfully position the renewed Wanzl portfolio in the market. 

• You take responsibility for major, existing key accounts in retail and proactively expand the C-level relationship network within complex Decision Making Units. 

• You actively identify market opportunities for product innovations (such as digital retail and automation solutions) and lead the acquisition process from A to Z, including complex price negotiations. 

• You implement structured and data-driven sales management (CRM, forecasting, and account planning) to achieve commercial performance and strict P&L and margin targets. 

• You work closely with the local sales and operational teams and the international headquarters to guarantee an optimal customer journey and efficient collaboration. 
 

• You hold a university degree and have 10 to 15 years of proven successful B2B sales and business development experience, preferably in retail or other relevant sector. 

• You are accustomed to operating in highly competitive markets and have experience managing complex key accounts. 

• You combine a strong commercial and entrepreneurial mindset with analytical skills and a P&L and margin focus, capable of translating data into concrete actions. 

• You have a proactive hands-on mentality and enjoy taking independent initiative to drive the business forward. 

• You communicate convincingly at various levels and are fluent in Dutch and French (required for the local market), as well as English (communications with HQ and other affiliates). Knowledge of German is a nice plus.

Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 28,000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

At Inetum Belgium, we offer more than just a job; we provide an inspiring environment and opportunities for growth and development. We strive to create a workplace where you can harness your talents, contribute to challenging projects, and be part of a leading IT consultancy group.

About Tiense Suikerraffinaderij
For nearly 200 years, Tiense Suikerraffinaderij has been producing sugar from local sugar beets, serving both industries and home kitchens. You'll become part of a family of 600 proud sugar makers who stick together, both on and off the factory floor. They operate with a refined blend of tradition and innovation, aiming for minimal environmental impact as nothing from our sugar beets goes to waste. Our mission? To make life sweeter for people worldwide. And we're excited to do it together with you!

Jobomschrijving

Sweet Challenges Await: Join Our Headquarters in Tienen 
Are you ready to make a sweet impact in a dynamic environment, right at the heart of sugar production? As a Business Controller, you act as a business partner to operations, sales and other departments of Tiense Suikerraffinaderij in Belgium. Our business controllers are responsible for the cost and margin analysis of processes related to the development, manufacturing and packaging of sugar products in our different factories. For this specific function, we look for a colleague who likes to focus on improvement of financial reporting tools and business performance dashboards.

Your job as Business Controller 
At Tiense Suikerraffinaderij, we boast an impressive lineup of 6 factories, each specializing in unique sugar processes. Ensuring optimal efficiency and cost effectiveness across all operations is essential to our success. Your main responsibilities are, together with your colleague business controller: 

• You develop automatic and easy-speaking cost analyses and dashboards. 
• You create added value by making recommendations and thus enabling well-founded business decisions. You develop, maintain and follow up on business data (e.g. budgets, forecasts, cost targets, KPI) and monitor cost efficiencies through the whole chain
• You play an active role in the monthly and yearly closings and the regular forecasting process.
• You report to the Director Controlling. You report to and work together with the colleagues of the Südzucker Group. 

It is in our roots. In yours too? 
At Tiense Suikerraffinaderij, we've been making sugar since 1836. The ingredients for success? They're ingrained in our roots:

• Flexibility and curiosity – We continue to invest in better, more sustainable and more efficient ways of working. As we modernise our processes and equipment, your expertise and ideas will help us make the right choices and drive continuous improvement.
• Technology and common sense – You'll work in a technologically advanced manufacturing environment where data, experience and common sense go hand in hand. By gaining insight into manufacturing costs and collaborating with colleagues across departments, you'll help turn insights into practical improvements.
• Solo and as a team – You'll enjoy a high degree of autonomy and the freedom to take ownership of your work. At the same time, you'll be part of a collaborative environment where teams support one another and work together towards shared goals.
You should also possess the following qualifications and experiences:

• Master's Degree (e.g. economics)
• Minimum 5 years of experience in business/operational controlling or in an analyst function
• A strong affinity with IT tools: 
• knowledge of Excel including pivot tables is essential
• experience in creating reports and dashboards with a modern tool set is required 
• knowledge of SAP FiCo / SAP BI is an asset 
• Excellent level of spoken and written Dutch and English; good level of French
• Strong competencies in and interest for business analytics, as well as a good understanding of accounting
• Hands-on, proactive, and solution-oriented approach

You will be responsible for the assembly and mounting of products.
You will be trained as a multi-skilled worker and deployed across 8 different workstations.

You are able to work in a two-shift system and can work both independently and as part of a team.
You already have some initial experience in assembly work.
You are punctual and work accurately.
You speak English or Dutch so that you can communicate with colleagues.

Are you an organised and service-oriented professional who enjoys being at the heart of office life? In this part-time role, you will support the daily operations of a busy international office, ensuring employees and visitors enjoy a seamless and welcoming workplace experience.

 

Client Details

Our client is an internationally active organisation with offices across multiple countries. Their Brussels team operates in a professional, collaborative and multicultural environment where efficiency, excellent service and teamwork are key to success.

As the organisation continues to grow, they are looking for a reliable Office Operations Assistant to help maintain smooth day-to-day office activities and provide essential administrative support.

 

Description

• Act as the first point of contact for visitors, answering calls and welcoming guests professionally.
• Provide administrative support including data entry, document preparation, proofreading and reporting.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, catering arrangements and logistics for internal meetings and events.
• Manage office supplies, kitchen stock, consumables and general workplace organisation.
• Handle incoming and outgoing mail, deliveries and courier services.
• Support facilities-related requests and liaise with external suppliers when needed.
• Assist with access badge administration, workspace set-up and daily office inspections.
• Prepare the office for opening and help maintain a clean, organised and professional working environment.
 

• You have at least 1 year of experience in administration, office coordination, reception or workplace support.
• You are comfortable using Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word and Excel.
• You communicate fluently in English. Knowledge of French and/or Dutch is considered an asset.
• You are highly organised, proactive and able to multitask effectively.
• You have a strong service mindset and enjoy supporting both colleagues and visitors.
• You are hands-on and willing to assist with practical office and facilities-related tasks.
• You are reliable, discreet and able to work independently.
• You are available to work on-site in Brussels on a part-time basis, Monday to Friday from 9AM to 1PM.

What will you have to do?
 

 
• Learn how to prepare our extensive range of chocolates
 
• You’ll learn the recipes so you can perform all tasks independently
 
• You’ll keep your workstation tidy, because that’s how you prefer to work
 
• As a line operator, you’ll set up the machine according to the correct parameters and adjust them as needed.
 
• You inspect the quality of the finished products.
 
• You supply the raw materials and packaging materials to the production line.
 
• Converting machines is also part of your responsibilities, as is cleaning and maintaining the production line. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You have a degree as a chocolatier, baker, or pastry chef OR possess the necessary experience
 
• Recent graduates in the fields of chocolatier, baker, or pastry chef are also welcome
 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5:00 AM–1:00 PM / 1:00 PM–9:00 PM)
 
• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards
 
• You have your own transportation
 
• You have a good to very good knowledge of Dutch or English
 
• You are willing to undergo in-house training
 
• You have a truly hands-on attitude
 
• You are a team player

What do you have to do?
 

 
• As a production line operator, you set up the machine according to the correct parameters and make adjustments as needed.
 
• You inspect the quality of the finished products.
 
• You supply raw materials and packaging materials to the production line.
 
• Your responsibilities will also include changing machine setups, as well as cleaning and maintaining the production line. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You are willing to work in the food industry
 
• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards
 
• You have your own transportation
 
• You have a good to very good knowledge of Dutch or English
 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5am-1pm and 1pm-9pm)
 
• You are willing to complete in-house training
 
• You have a truly hands-on attitude
 
• You are a team player

Do you also love the idea of working in chocolate? Then this opportunity is definitely for you! We are looking for production workers who can help out during the upcoming chocolate season. What will you be doing?
 

 
• Packing pralines, seashell chocolates, chocolate bars, etc. into boxes
 
• Labeling finished products and pallets
 
• Tying ribbons around praline boxes
 
• Applying stickers to finished products
 
• Wrapping boxes in foil
 
• Carrying out quality control checks 

Who are you?
 

 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5 a.m.–1 p.m. / 1 p.m.–9 p.m.) or possibly a fixed night shift (9 p.m.–5 a.m.)
 
• You have a good knowledge of the Dutch or English language
 
• You have your own mode of transport
 
• You are flexible regarding working hours
 
• You are willing to work in the food industry

Are you a hands-on and service-minded professional who enjoys creating a welcoming and well-organised workplace? In this varied role, you will ensure the smooth daily operation of a modern international office while acting as a key contact for employees, visitors and external service providers.

 

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international organisation based in Brussels, bringing together professionals and stakeholders from across Europe. Operating in a dynamic and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in supporting collaboration, policy development and industry best practices on an international scale.

With employees and members from numerous countries, the organisation offers a collaborative workplace where professionalism, continuous improvement and teamwork are highly valued.

 

Description

• Welcome visitors and act as the main point of contact for employees, guests and external partners.
• Ensure the office remains operational, organised and ready for daily business activities.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, prepare meeting spaces and support internal events and workshops.
• Manage office supplies, catering services, incoming and outgoing mail, and document archiving.
• Liaise with external suppliers and service providers to ensure smooth facility operations.
• Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance of building systems and office equipment.
• Support workspace optimisation projects, including storage and inventory management.
• Contribute to creating a professional, safe and pleasant working environment for all employees and visitors.
 

• Secondary education diploma or equivalent experience.
• Initial experience (1 to 3 years) in office coordination, workplace services, hospitality, reception or administrative support.
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English, combined with a good knowledge of either French or Dutch. Knowledge of both is a strong asset.
• Customer-oriented and proactive mindset with a strong sense of service.
• Organised and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Reliable, discreet and able to work autonomously while remaining a true team player.
• Available to work on-site on a full-time basis.

Robert Half is currently looking for a PAN-EU Financial Controller (M/F/X) for a company located in the Beringen region.

Our client is an international organization with a well-established European hub in Belgium. jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer English-German-Dutch – Day Shift
jobs.description:
As a Customer Service Officer, you’ll be part of a multicultural, multilingual support platform. Every day, our team ensures that our customers’ vehicles and trucks are back on the road as quickly as possible. You’ll work in a close-knit team with the support of a team leader and helpful colleagues. You’ll meet new people with unique backgrounds and stories, and you’ll have the opportunity to learn new things daily.

Your key responsibilities include handling incoming phone calls and emails, responding to customer queries and liaising with third parties. You’ll gather and verify information for accuracy and completeness, provide technical support, and communicate with service workshops. Keeping customers and all stakeholders informed is essential, as is monitoring and managing agreements with all parties. You’ll also follow up on all contract-related matters within set deadlines. The core working schedule is Monday to Friday, with flexibility to work Saturdays during busy periods. Shifts are rotated between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM.

An average day will see you juggling multiple customer queries, coordinating with technical teams, ensuring accurate and timely communication, and resolving any issues that may come up. You’ll need to multitask, prioritize tasks, and maintain a high standard of accuracy and customer service.

If you’re ready to take on a fast-paced, varied role in a supportive and international environment, apply now and start your journey in customer service!

• Professional bachelor’s degree or higher secondary education

• Excellent spoken English, good German and Dutch language skills

• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook)

• Strong verbal communication skills, analytical and problem-solving ability

• Customer-oriented, results-driven, accurate, and able to multitask under pressure

• Technical knowledge (automotive, tires, etc.) is a plus, but not required

• No specific work experience required; open to juniors and starters

• Able to work shifts between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM, Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturdays
